name: Petal
source:
A boy makes breakfast and wakes me up.
I thought it was a dream, but it seems to be a reality. But he's unfriendly, cheeky, and looks at me like he's looking at garbage...
Anyway, I wish I knew a straightforward and kind boy.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6136]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
有个男孩做好早餐，叫我起床。
我还以为这是在做梦，没想到竟然是真的。可这家伙冷淡、没大没小，看我的眼神就像在看垃圾…
要是能遇到一个坦率又温柔的男孩就好了。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6136]NovelGame[/url]]
